name: Coleus forskohlii (forskolin)
short: In four small trials adverse effects were generally mild and infrequent. In a user survey, 10.5% reported adverse events, mostly diarrhoea, which was more likely with larger amounts.
text: A systematic review of four randomised trials of Coleus forskohlii extract for obesity found that adverse effects were generally mild and infrequent, and called for long-term, high-quality trials to confirm safety. A nationwide online survey of people using marketed products gives a less favourable picture: 75 users (10.5% of all users) reported adverse events, 92% of which were gastrointestinal, with diarrhoea alone making up 81.3%; the amount of extract taken was significantly associated with diarrhoea. The survey relied on self-report rather than a controlled comparison. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
